messages:
viv: quick note
bout onboarding thalys-11b-int4 on Dedicated tonight. reproducible transient OOMs during warmup when short chats mix with a single long >2k token generation. small hit on long-doc rouge. posting config + repro.

samir: drop the runner config + allocator lines?

viv: runner (trimmed):
```
model: thalys-11b-int4
batch_target: auto
max_new_tokens: 180
kv_prefetch: full
slot_compactor_interval: 60s
soft_reserve: 0.10
```
repro: cold hosts, 10 concurrent chats ~150 tokens, then one long summarize ~2.4k tokens -> node shows low free slots then transient OOM; compactor reclaims ~500-700MiB and host recovers.

elaine: allocator snippet:
```
[2026-03-24T22:10:01Z] gpu_alloc fail 1.05GiB
[2026-03-24T22:10:02Z] kv_live=3.85GiB
[2026-03-24T22:10:03Z] free_slots_frac=0.03
[2026-03-24T22:10:06Z] compactor reclaimed=540MiB
```

samir: two safe levers: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens to 56 for this quant variant, 2) set kv_prefetch_window=256 and enable kv_trim at 512 tokens with trim_ratio=0.25. also try batch_pacing_ms=35 to smooth burst allocations.

elaine: also add a short canary: 3% Dedicated, run 2k requests or 6 hours, capture long-doc rouge harness (120 samples) + perf. targets: p95 token latency <160ms, memory cushion >=512MiB after warmup, rouge >= baseline - 0.7. rollback if cushion <256MiB or rouge delta >0.7.

ops-bot: :gear: canary created for thalys-11b-int4 -> 3% dedicated canary. PR #1999 opened by viv.

viv: opening PR with config and canary plan now. will post eval results in this thread. :rocket:
